content:
Review guidance on the user's ACTUAL requirement, which overrides the original bug-B acceptance criterion. Judge the following as a REQUIRED fix (needs_revision) if not met.

BLOCKER / MUST-FIX — Pending Signals table redesign:
The user explicitly asked: "giữ lại 3 cột asset, dir, entry, thêm một cột Time đầu tiên và cột chứa nút 'check' ở cuối cùng" = keep exactly 3 columns asset/dir/entry, ADD a Time column FIRST, and a check button column LAST. So the Pending Signals table must be exactly 5 columns: [Time, Asset, Dir, Entry, check]. Stop Loss / Take Profit / Rule Score / Model Prob / Send Order must be REMOVED from the row and live inside the inspect popup (full precision, plus the 50-candle chart + editable auto lot + Send Order button).

The engineer instead KEPT the 8-column layout and added an "Inspect" button to the existing Action column. That does NOT satisfy the requirement. The "Model Prob header must render unclipped" acceptance criterion is OBSOLETE once the user's redesign moves Model Prob into the popup — there is no header to unclip. The user's feature supersedes it.

SECONDARY (confirm whether acceptable, flag as minor if so): the engineer inlined the candle/chart/risk helpers into gui_tab_live.py rather than adding the SystemBridge candle method + separate chart widget file, because the t2 contract in-scope was gui_tab_live.py-only. The user confirmed scope includes gui_bridge.py + a chart widget file. This is a refactor concern (functional), not a blocker.

Please verify the current implementation against the 5-column redesign requirement and the popup contents (send order, adjustable auto lot, entry/SL/TP, rule score + model prob, 50-candle QPainter chart with entry marker + dashed TP green / SL red / Entry white), then return your verdict with concrete file:line findings.
